_meta.description: Storm descent schedule. Storm consumes one region every ~3.5 min. No Sudden Death. Anyone not in Core Hollow by 17:30 dies. Timings LOCKED; damage values TBD.
_meta.status: TIMINGS LOCKED — damage THIRD-PASS 2026-08-01 (all TBD). Phase count, names, start/end are untouched; only damage_per_second changed.
_meta._balanced: 2026-07-05 first-pass; 2026-07-06 reduction; 2026-07-31 second pass; 2026-08-01 third pass (loiter-time pass) — testable values pending playtesting
_meta._tbd: 2026-08-01 (LOITER-TIME PASS): all live phases cut again — Crust 1.0->0.8 (-20%), Mantle 2.0->1.5 (-25%), Outer Core 4.0->2.5 (-38%), Inner Core 6.5->4.0 (-38%), Core Hollow 1.5->1.0 (-33%). Atmosphere left at 0.2 (unreachable). Escalation preserved: 0.2 < 0.8 < 1.5 < 2.5 < 4.0, with Core Hollow deliberately below Inner Core. REASON: playtesting could not reach the layers where Epic/Legendary loot actually drops (Outer Core / Inner Core) — combined dps there killed a full-health player in 16s / 8.5s, which is less time than it takes to open a chest, so deep-tier gear and every Epic/Legendary weapon passive were effectively unreachable content. The deep phases took the largest cuts for that reason. This pass was made TOGETHER with cuts to pressure_dps_base (2.0->0.8) and depth_hazard layer dps in world_config.json — the storm was never the dominant term deep down and cutting it alone would not have fixed the problem. Still placeholder / TBD pending playtest, NOT locked final.
_meta._combined_note: TIME-TO-KILL IS THE SUM OF THREE SYSTEMS, NOT THE STORM ALONE. A player above the storm front also takes depth_hazard.<layer>_dps and pressure (pressure_dps_base x LAYER_DEPTH_FACTOR), all three bypassing armor. AMBIENT dps with NO storm (depth + pressure only — this is what caps how long a player can loiter and loot a layer), vs a 100 HP player: Crust 0 (unlimited) | Mantle 0.2+0.16 = 0.36 (~278s) | Outer Core 0.5+0.32 = 0.82 (~122s) | Inner Core 1.0+0.48 = 1.48 (~68s) | Core Hollow 0+0.64 = 0.64 (~156s). CAUGHT IN THE STORM at that depth, all three stacking: Crust 0.8 (~125s) | Mantle 1.86 (~54s) | Outer Core 3.32 (~30s) | Inner Core 5.48 (~18s) | Core Hollow after 17:30 1.64 (~61s). Tune against these totals, not the storm column on its own.
_meta._balance_note: Per-phase damage_per_second is an escalating curve, forgiving early -> dangerous late. Storm damage BYPASSES armor (armor_applies=false, LOCKED 2026-07-06 — reduce these base values, never that behaviour), so these are raw HP/sec. Storm-only time-to-kill on a 100-HP player after the 2026-08-01 cuts: Crust ~125s, Mantle ~67s, Outer Core ~40s, Inner Core ~25s. See _combined_note for the figures that actually matter (storm + depth + pressure stack). Each phase lasts 210s, so being caught is survivable-but-urgent at every depth rather than ignorable. DESIGN SPLIT applied 2026-08-01: the STORM is the clock (it should force you to keep descending), while depth+pressure are an attrition tax that makes you spend consumables — the ambient hazards must never be a harder timer than the storm itself, which is what they had become at Inner Core (5.2 ambient dps vs 6.5 storm). WIRED 2026-07-06: StormSystem._current_storm_dps() reads these per-phase values (indexed by the authoritative elapsed-time phase index). The flat storm_dps (12.0) in world_config.json remains only as a null-safety fallback.
_meta._atmosphere_note: Atmosphere's 0.2 is UNREACHABLE and deliberately left unchanged. During this phase get_storm_front_y() returns -9999, so StormSystem._is_player_in_storm() returns false and no damage is ever applied. The value is kept non-zero only so the curve stays meaningful if the storm is ever made active during Atmosphere.
_meta._core_hollow_fix: 20.0 -> 2.0. THE CURVE WAS NON-VIABLE AT THE FINALE. For the final phase get_storm_front_y() returns world_height_px (the very bottom of the world), so _is_player_in_storm() (player.y < front_y) is TRUE for EVERY living player — including the finalists standing inside the Core Hollow, who are exactly the players the deadline is supposed to reward. At 20 dps every survivor died within ~5s of 17:30, so the Core Hollow showdown — the designed climax of the match — could never actually be fought, and every match ended at ~17:35 regardless of skill. Note the deadline instakill in StormSystem._check_deadline() already handles anyone NOT in the Core Hollow, so this value only ever affects the intended survivors. 2.0 dps was chosen for a ~50s finale, but that estimate was WRONG because it counted the storm alone: pressure also applies inside the Core Hollow (LAYER_DEPTH_FACTOR 0.8, and depth_hazard.core_hollow_dps is 0), so the real total was 2.0 + 2.4 = 4.4 dps ≈ 23s. The 2026-07-31 (b) pass cut storm to 1.5 and pressure_dps_base to 2.0 (1.5 + 1.6 = 3.1 dps ≈ 32s); the 2026-08-01 pass cuts storm to 1.0 and pressure_dps_base to 0.8, giving 1.0 + 0.64 = 1.64 dps ≈ 61s — a finale long enough to actually fight in, ending the match around 18:31, inside the 18-22 minute design length. THE CURVE IS INTENTIONALLY NON-MONOTONIC AT THE LAST PHASE (Inner Core 4.0 -> Core Hollow 1.0). Do not 'restore' it to an escalating value without first changing how the final-phase storm front is computed, and do not tune it without including pressure in the total.
_meta._next_lever: If playtesting says the storm still under-pressures, raise Crust/Mantle before the deep phases — a player caught deep is usually already committed, whereas an early-phase player is the one choosing to loiter.
